{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items felt like something I would choose now. The threaded inserts came closest because they relate to wood assembly, but I have no need for that particular connection.",
    "The nuts recognized my interest in fastening supplies, although they serve different needs from the nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors I recently chose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My recent nails and screws serve specific construction tasks; lock nuts require matching bolts, and threaded inserts require a particular threaded connection that I have not shown a need for.",
    "The three heat shrink products assume I have a wiring project, but my recent fastening purchases give me no reason to choose electrical insulation or sealing supplies.",
    "Steel wool, moisture absorbers, and plastic bonder each address a separate task that I do not currently have.",
    "Buying medicine cups does not mean I also need disposable gloves, especially when the recommended size is not established by my history."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treated general workshop usefulness as a reason I would need an item now.",
    "They treated different kinds of fasteners as interchangeable, even though wood screws, framing nails, nuts, and threaded inserts solve different problems.",
    "The medicine cups seemed to suggest a broader need for medical supplies than that single purchase supports."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors provide a stronger clue to my current needs than a general interest in tools and supplies.",
    "Dimensions, connection type, and compatibility matter to me: a nearby use case is not enough if the item does not fit the task.",
    "My vacuum bags were replacements for specified Panasonic types, which also shows why an exact fit can matter more than broad usefulness."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized an interest in practical supplies but stretched it into unrelated projects and fastening needs I do not currently have."
}"}
